Digi-Key 3827, Active (api.digikey.com/products/v4/search/LTC4352CMS%23TRPBF/productdetails, 2026-10-03T00:26:57Z) does not count for an on-board part (rule 1) and the library holds 0. added.spec_line: Research.md V301 (R5, pack disconnect): "10 µA stays, with an operator wake contact for a start from the pack alone" (owner, 2026-10-02)
added.description: The operator wake contact has no function and no part. FU-2I/003-P2-R5.json (BQ40Z80RSMR requirement 'start from the pack alone', source SLUSBV4D 5.3, read 2026-10-03T00:13:54Z) states 'a contact from the pack to PACK wakes it' and marks the requirement pass with no part for the contact. selection.json (round2) has no function for it, and a switch or push button is not a stage 2 type (resistors, capacitors, inductors, crystals, connectors, connector protection, MOSFETs). It is the same kind of line as the BOOT and RESET buttons of gap 5. Without the contact the pack cannot start after a disconnect when no DC input or charger is present.

added.description: The energy a braking servo returns into its port is not found. FU-2I/004-P2-R6.json report 'Servo rail clamp energy and peak current' (Savox SH-0255MG+ and SB-2290SG pages, vendors.py fetch HTTP 200, 2026-10-03T00:30:19Z and 00:30:20Z): 'Energy absorbed: not known; no servo data sheet read states the energy a braking servo returns', only blocking currents of 1.4 A and 10.5 A. The same return lists it under 'Values not found'; FU-2I/026-P4-datasheet-R6.json confirms it absent (read_at 2026-10-03T01:51:29Z). The clamp's load resistor pulse rating and the rail capacitance with servos attached are therefore unsized. P6 lists V129 from the same 'Values not found' entry but not this value.
